2608.04772.title: Guideline-as-Oracle: Zero-Annotation Training of an Ophthalmic Telephone Triage Agent
2608.04772.paper_summary: Scaling supervision for multi-turn medical agents is difficult because expert dialogue annotation is costly and clinical conversations are privacy-restricted. We introduce Guideline-as-Oracle (GAO), which compiles American Academy of Ophthalmology guidance into a 70-row operational rule table and uses it as the sole source of instance-level supervision for 3,000 training dialogues, reserving human labeling for evaluation. Because converting rules into dialogues is itself a design problem, we catalog eight construction strategies, including cited-row tier assignment, one-fact boundary pairs, metadata-only repair, and label repair, and characterize the evidential status of each: labeling mechanism, null, confounded, or evaluated only as a package. Fine-tuning a 9B backbone on this corpus yields GAO-Triage, improving agreement with a 201-case operational reference from 61.7% to 74.1% (exact McNemar p=0.0046) and emergent-case recall from 9.5% to 69.0%; the gains persist across a second seed and patient simulator. None of the seven general-purpose systems we test dominates GAO-Triage on both metrics, and GAO-Triage requires no frontier model at inference time. Permuting label-dialogue assignments collapses the model to a constant-routine predictor, indicating that the signal lies in guideline-derived assignment rather than dialogue surface form. Label repair coincides with the disappearance of a late-training safety degradation.
2608.04772.paper_summary_zh: 多輪醫療代理的監督擴展是困難的，因為專家的對話標註成本高昂且臨床對話受到隱私限制。我們介紹了指導方針作為神諭（GAO），它將美國眼科學會的指導方針編纂成一個70行的操作規則表，並將其作為3,000個訓練對話的唯一實例級監督來源，將人工標註保留用於評估。由於將規則轉換為對話本身就是一個設計問題，我們列出了八種構建策略，包括引用行層級分配、單事實邊界對、僅元數據修復和標籤修復，並描述了每種策略的證據狀態：標註機制、無、混淆或僅作為一個包進行評估。在該語料庫上微調9B骨幹模型產生了GAO-Triage，將與201案例操作參考的協議從61.7%提高到74.1%（精確的McNemar p=0.0046），並將新出現案例的召回率從9.5%提高到69.0%；這些增益在第二個種子和患者模擬器中持續存在。我們測試的七個通用系統中，沒有一個在這兩個指標上超越GAO-Triage，並且GAO-Triage在推理時不需要前沿模型。標籤-對話分配的排列使模型崩潰為一個常數例行預測器，這表明信號存在於指導方針派生的分配中，而不是對話的表面形式。標籤修復與晚期訓練安全降級的消失相吻合。
